hero.headline: Bridging infrastructure, software and AI to solve real problems.
hero.resumen: I administer Linux and Windows systems, work with networking and cloud infrastructure, and build automation tools, software and applied AI integrations. My approach combines professional experience, personal projects and practical learning.

parrafos: I currently work as a Systems Administrator at EXO, gaining hands-on experience in enterprise environments involving Linux, SaltStack, Docker, Microsoft Azure and Yocto. My background also includes hosting, networking, server maintenance and technical troubleshooting.

Since 2015, I have developed SolarisPKN, a collection of personal projects connecting web applications, automation, streaming tools, AI assistants and self-hosted services. I enjoy designing the architecture as much as implementing, testing, documenting and improving its components.

My experience also includes automotive electronics and diagnostics. That background shaped a practical approach: investigate root causes, measure outcomes and deliver solutions people can actually use.
sobreMi.texto: My work combines systems administration, software tools, automation, applied AI and practical problem-solving.

items.texto: Systems administration and hands-on learning in enterprise infrastructure. Labs involving SaltStack automation, Docker containers, Microsoft Azure, and embedded Linux builds with Yocto. Troubleshooting and technical documentation.

Infrastructure design and administration for personal projects and clients: Linux and Windows servers, networking, hosting, VPS, Cloudflare, development tools, automation, streaming and AI integration. Projects documented on GitHub.
Vehicle diagnostics using OBD-II and DTC interpretation, sensor and actuator testing, ECU analysis and automotive wiring diagrams. Repairs and systematic troubleshooting for customers.
Managed Debian servers via SSH for an e-commerce platform: website deployment, hosting, domains, DNS, HTTPS, SSL/TLS certificates, performance, incident response and technical SEO.
